title: Church & Dwight acquires minority stake in curl-focused hair care business
summary: An agreement has been signed which will see consumer goods company Church & Dwight take a 45% stake in hair care and styling company Bali Treatment GmbH, owner of Bali Curls and Bali Gents

extraction.key_fact: Church & Dwight가 Bali Curls와 Bali Gents를 가진 헤어 케어 회사 Bali Treatment GmbH의 소수 지분을 인수하기로 했다.
